locale.description: Locale setting to ensure proper UTF-8 representation of non-ASCII characters. Corresponds to LANG/LC_CTYPE environment variables.

check_file.description: Path to the file containing checksums and filenames to be verified with -c option.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode (-v flag). Prints filenames when checking.

progress.description: Show progress during hashing (-p flag). Prints percentage of completeness.

mmap.description: Use mmap instead of read for file hashing (-m flag). Can be faster depending on system.

warn_format.description: Warn on improperly formatted lines when checking (-w flag).

files.description: List of files to process. Each item contains path and optional checksum for verification mode.
